thesis: The speakers discuss Asif Suria's book 'The Event Driven Edge in Investing,' which outlines six event-driven strategies such as merger arbitrage and stock buybacks. Suria argues that while some strategies like merger arbitrage may not work well in current high-interest rate environments, others like spin-offs are becoming more attractive, requiring investors to continuously adapt to macro conditions.
